episodes.title: Parte 1
episodes.summary: Samuel discovers his mom owes thousands of euros in rent and he must find a way to reimburse the landlords to avoid eviction.

episodes.title: Parte 2
episodes.summary: Omar helps Samuel take enticing photos for his new "Only For You" website, but their plan goes awry.

episodes.title: Parte 3
episodes.summary: Samuel is despondent about the consequences of his actions, but his friends offer him hope... and a provocative idea.
